The per-fold cost drag is small (median +0.000, mean +0.001) relative to the ~+0.05..+0.11 per-fold momentum edge, because the constant-notional daily-rebalance rule trades only the incremental delta each bar (low realized turnover). Mechanism worth preserving: the 'daily rebalance = prohibitive turnover' intuition does not hold for constant-notional sizing, since only the price-drift delta is traded each bar; the existing cost model is therefore a mild drag on this implementation.
